examples.question_text: By sketching each base function and reciprocating, sketch (a) $y=\frac1{(x+2)^2}$ and (b) $y=\frac1{(x+2)^3}$. Label the asymptotes and invariant points.
Let $f(x)=\frac{x-2}{x+2}$, with domain $\mathbb R\setminus\{-2\}$. Find the equation and domain of $g(x)=1/f(x)$, then sketch $g$, marking any excluded point and its asymptotes.

methods.description: Reciprocate a supplied line's ordinates; use its zero, sign, invariant points and end behaviour to sketch the reciprocal and label its intercepts and asymptotes.
methods.sourceRef: booklets/mathsmap-sources/Stage 6 Extension 1/Further Work with Functions 1_Graphical relationships.md lines 112-170, Investigation; lines 195-203, item a

methods.description: Reciprocate a quadratic with two zeros, preserving signs, marking two vertical asymptotes and converting its non-zero turning-point ordinate.
methods.sourceRef: booklets/mathsmap-sources/Stage 6 Extension 1/Further Work with Functions 1_Graphical relationships.md lines 195-208, item b; lines 287-298, Foundation question 5

methods.description: Reciprocate a positive quadratic with no zeros; convert its minimum to a maximum and use reversed monotonicity and the horizontal asymptote to sketch the graph.
methods.sourceRef: booklets/mathsmap-sources/Stage 6 Extension 1/Further Work with Functions 1_Graphical relationships.md lines 161-170; lines 247-252, Foundation question 1 and image51.png

methods.description: Sketch or recognise the reciprocal of a shifted square, using its repeated zero, positive sign on both sides, invariant points and same-sided infinite behaviour.
methods.sourceRef: booklets/mathsmap-sources/Stage 6 Extension 1/Further Work with Functions 1_Graphical relationships.md lines 271-277, Foundation question 3; lines 359-368, Mastery question 8b

methods.description: Sketch or recognise the reciprocal of a shifted cube, retaining opposite signs on either side of its zero and the corresponding one-sided infinite behaviour.
methods.sourceRef: booklets/mathsmap-sources/Stage 6 Extension 1/Further Work with Functions 1_Graphical relationships.md lines 279-285, Foundation question 4; lines 375-378, Mastery question 8d

methods.description: Simplify a reciprocal while retaining original excluded inputs, exclude zeros of the original function, and distinguish holes from vertical asymptotes; reciprocate a non-zero horizontal limit.
methods.sourceRef: booklets/mathsmap-sources/Stage 6 Extension 1/Further Work with Functions 1_Graphical relationships.md lines 158-159; lines 409-419, Mastery question 9
